official: 横浜市認定こども園の要件を定める条例の一部改正

sources.label: 議案一覧（令和8年第1回定例会）

name: 認定こども園の1学級を35人から30人に
summary: 幼保連携型認定こども園以外の認定こども園では、満3歳以上の子ども35人につき1学級を設け、各学級に職員を1人以上置く基準です。改正後は、基準人数が30人になります。条例は令和8年4月1日に施行されますが、施行時にすでにある施設は、令和14年3月31日まで従来の基準を適用できます。
changes: 1学級あたりの満3歳以上の子どもの基準人数を35人から30人に改める
従来の基準を適用できる経過措置を設ける
who: 幼保連携型以外の認定こども園に通う満3歳以上の子どもとその保護者
幼保連携型以外の認定こども園の運営者
why: 国の基準改正に伴い、幼保連携型認定こども園以外の認定こども園で1学級の満3歳以上の子どもの数を減らすためと、市は説明しています。

en.name: Reduces the class-size standard at certified childcare centers from 35 to 30
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance Establishing Requirements for Yokohama City Certified Early Childhood Education and Care Centers
en.summary: At certified early childhood education and care centers other than integrated centers, the standard is one class for every 35 children aged 3 or older, with at least one staff member in each class. Under the amendment, the standard number of children becomes 30. The ordinance takes effect on April 1, 2026. Facilities already in operation when it takes effect may continue to use the previous standard until March 31, 2032.
changes: Reduces the standard number of children aged 3 or older per class from 35 to 30
Allows facilities to continue applying the previous standard during a transition period
who: Children aged 3 or older attending certified centers other than integrated centers, and their parents or guardians
Operators of certified centers other than integrated centers
en.why: The city says the change is intended to reduce the number of children aged 3 or older in each class at certified centers other than integrated centers, following a revision to the national standards.
